Pune Fort Murder: Police Detail Alleged Conspiracy and Signal

Police in Pune are investigating the alleged murder of Ketan Agarwal, with reports detailing a planned conspiracy. Investigators state that Siya Goyal, the victim's fiancée, allegedly used a "sitting down" signal, such as tying shoelaces, to prompt her lover, Chetan Chaudhary, to push Agarwal off Lohagad Fort. The accused reportedly planned to evade detection and have had their vehicle seized.
